name: Pickled rau móp
summary: Pickled rau móp, sour, crisp, and cool, made from the young leaves and tips.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế calls rau móp muối chua a specialty of the district and also pairs it with steamed beef.
howToEat: Eat the pickle. The same account also stir-fries rau móp with garlic, cooks it as sour soup, steams it with chicken, and tosses it with chicken, shrimp, or beef, including steamed beef.
